name: Vietnamese Voice route comparison 2026-11-13
limitations: 80 clips represent only8 public recording origins plus16 authored texts; variants are correlated.
Human speech has no scam labels: no human-scam or human-benign content claim. The full four-way labeled matrix is incomplete.
Acoustic sources were used in earlier local research; test is speaker-disjoint from development in this comparison, not a new external corpus.
Content controls are new texts from one installed voice; not generator-disjoint. Nano development/Turbo acoustic test are separate generator families.
Noise/phone are simulations; no physical microphone or real-call evaluation.
